Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component

Class MultiBlock

java.lang.Object
dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component.MultiBlock
All Implemented Interfaces:
BlockTrait
@BedrockFormat("1.26.10") @BedrockExperiment("upcoming_creator_features") public final class MultiBlock extends Object implements BlockTrait
Adds the minecraft:multi_block_part states to a block to define the block as a multi-block composed of multiple block parts. Defining this trait on your block means you cannot define any other trait except minecraft:placement_direction trait to set the minecraft:cardinal_direction state. This state requires Minecraft Bedrock version 1.26.10 and above. Before version 1.26.40, the experimental toggle "Upcoming Creator Features" is required.

Add-on JSON: "minecraft:multi_block". The creator docs name the experiment Upcoming Creator Features for it (in some format versions); BDS-verified: in a world without experiments BDS rejects it in 1.26.36.1. BDS takes it without any experiment in 26.40, 26.50, 26.60, 26.70: the docs' gating does not hold there.

Since:
1.0.0
